intro: The circus arrived overnight in a town that isn't on any map, and by morning the big top stood whole and smelling of boiled canvas and burnt sugar, as if the road itself had unrolled it. The performers move through their paces without a word between them, each one carrying a small tin notebook stitched to the wrist, in which they jot what the audience saw and, beneath it, what they themselves nearly did. The ticket-taker checks each hand at the flap with a squint, and lets you in only if your admission bears a single deliberate flaw, set before you even approached. Somewhere under the grandstand a proof-reader has been at work since midnight, going over every programme page with a steady nib, leaving one small correction in the margin of each.
echo: The painted horses go up and down and round, and never get anywhere.

puzzles.title: Centre Ring
puzzles.flavor: The host was particular about the seating, and more particular still about what each chair was worth.

clues: Exactly 3 people sit between Emerson and Gilbert.
Ashley sits somewhere between Barnaby and Emerson.
Malcolm sits somewhere between Barnaby and Gilbert.
Desmond sits somewhere between Emilia and Malcolm.
Desmond sits immediately to the right of Ashley.

meta.title: Meta: The Travelling Show
meta.flavor: Nothing reached the big top undamaged. The damage, though, was remarkably consistent.
hints: Did every answer come out clean the first time? Each had exactly one wrong letter. Did you keep them?
